reason: The lane-born stars are approaching the returning galaxy, so its stellar outskirts are the natural place to follow their passage.

choice.combine: Young stars from the dark lane
choice.with: Stellar outskirts of the returning galaxy

expectation: The stars will pass through the returning galaxy's outskirts, with their paths altered by its gravity.

effect: The lane-born stars passed through the returning galaxy and became part of a shared stellar body, completing the goal.
reaction: I found the contrast between the stars passing through and their parent gas clouds colliding satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Sending the lane-born stars through the stellar outskirts was worthwhile because it showed how becoming stars changed their encounter with another galaxy.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter ended after one straightforward combination, leaving little opportunity to explore its other visible hotspot.

surprise.text: The result clarified that the stars’ paths change without their crushing together, unlike their parent clouds.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the approaching stars and the outskirts made the combination clear.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the shared stellar body develops, though this chapter was too short to offer much gameplay variety.
